description: IDELUX - déchets ménagers collectés par commune (2020 et 2021) is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IDELUX. Quantités de déchets ménagers collectés en 2020 par commune en KG: collectes en porte à porte + recyparc + poubelles communales. Coverage: Province of Luxembourg (Wallonia). The portal lists 6 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are collecte, déchet, quantiter, recyparcs. The portal shows 55 records. The most recent modification among them is 2022-11-29 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
